details:
- Rebuild against recent Go compiler
- CVE-2025-61726: fix net/url excessive memory consumption when parsing large
  forms with many unique query parameters
- CVE-2025-61729: fix crypto/x509 certificate verification allowing excessive
  resource consumption via HostnameError.Error()
- CVE-2025-68121: fix crypto/tls session resumption succeeding when it should
  fail due to mutated ClientCAs or RootCAs between handshakes
